synthesizedFacts.fact: Hormonal acne is primarily caused by hormonal changes that increase sebum production, leading to clogged pores.
Topical treatments such as retinoids, benzoyl peroxide, and salicylic acid are commonly used for treating hormonal acne.
Oral contraceptives and anti-androgen drugs can be effective in managing hormonal acne by balancing hormone levels.
Lifestyle changes such as reducing stress, getting adequate sleep, and using non-comedogenic skincare products can help manage hormonal acne.
Natural remedies like tea tree oil and green tea have limited evidence for effectiveness in treating hormonal acne.
